title: SubFaction Template
description: Schema for a procgen sub_faction template. Per ADR-0014. World generation instantiates this template multiple times to produce procgen sub_factions (e.g., 'warring_kingdom' might produce 3-5 instances per world). Lives in sub_faction_templates/<template_id>/data.json.

name_patterns.description: Procedural name generation for sub_faction instances. The {name} placeholder in title_format receives the sub_faction name produced by sampling the culture's sub_faction_name_patterns.

pattern.description: Optional override. Generative pattern using {family_name}, {place_root}, etc. drawn from the sub_faction's culture name tables. If omitted, the culture's sub_faction_name_patterns are used directly.

title_format.description: Display-name format. Available placeholder: {name} (the sampled sub_faction name). Examples: 'Kingdom of {name}', 'The Free Cities of {name}', '{name} Conclave'.

culture.description: Default culture URN. Individual instances may pick from a list if multiple cultures fit this template.

culture_pool.description: Optional. Pool of culture URNs to sample from. Overrides 'culture' if present. A pool with a single entry is valid (semantically identical to setting 'culture' to that entry).

initial_state_ranges.description: Sampled ranges for initial Sub-Faction State Vector parameters per ADR-0020. Each instance draws values from these ranges at world generation.

placement_rules.description: Where instances of this template are placed at world gen.

min_distance_from_other_sub_factions_til.description: Minimum tile-graph distance from other sub_factions at world gen.

count_at_world_gen.description: How many instances of this template to generate per world.

ruler_template.description: NPC template used to generate the ruler. Each sub_faction instance gets a procgen ruler from this template.

npc_templates_used.description: NPC templates that procedurally populate instances of this sub_faction.

coefficient_overrides.description: Overrides for Turchin coefficients. Defaults come from the culture.

typical_relationships.description: Default attitudes toward other sub_faction templates. Procgen instances inherit these as baseline.

lore_pattern.description: Templated lore prose. Available placeholders: {ruler_name} (the procgen ruler's display_name), {capital_name} (procgen capital or first tile name), {founding_year} (sampled int from world_gen), {name} (the sub_faction's sampled name). Defaults to culture-driven lore generation if omitted.

pentagon_seeding_template.description: Per ADR-0018. Optional Pentagon-specific overrides for when this sub_faction template is selected to seed a Pentagon Site. If a culture is procgen-selected for a Pentagon Site and this template applies, world-gen uses these overrides instead of generic frontier sub_faction generation. Lets a culture express what its Pentagon-seeded sub_faction specifically looks like (size, ruler template, named NPCs at the canonical site, lore pattern).

ruler_template_override.description: Optional npc_template URN to use as the ruler when seeded at a Pentagon (e.g., a more legendary ruler than the generic frontier template would produce).

named_npcs.description: Authored named NPC URNs that exist at this Pentagon-seeded sub_faction (the canonical site lore characters).

lore_pattern_override.description: Optional lore pattern override for Pentagon-seeded sub_factions (typically referencing the Pentagon as the ancestral seat).

initial_state_overrides.description: Optional State Vector overrides for the Pentagon-seeded variant (e.g., higher cohesion and mandate to reflect a founding capital). Per ADR-0020.
